title: Where can zonnevelden (solar fields) be sited in province Utrecht? Decision table (programming stage)

rows.criterion: A 'zonneveld' (Bijlage I) is any grouping of solar panels placed on or above the ground or on the water surface, but not on roofs of buildings: the object definition tha…
rows.norm: Bijlage I, begrip 'zonneveld' — Omgevingsverordening provincie Utrecht (CVDR704250, geldend 13-10-2025) - begripsbepaling (Bijlage I) [binding]
rows.note: Definitional scope of the object type 'zonneveld' (Bijlage I): ground/water-mounted panel groupings, roofs excluded. Carries no zone or threshold semantics to execute.

rows.criterion: Within the 'Gebied zonneveld' an omgevingsplan may contain rules allowing the realisation of solar-energy generation by means of zonnevelden, provided (a) the structures…
rows.norm: art. 5.5, eerste lid — Omgevingsverordening provincie Utrecht (CVDR704250, geldend 13-10-2025) - artikeltekst [binding]
rows.note: CORE ZON RULE. Art. 5.5 lid 1 permits, within the 'Gebied zonneveld' (GIO Bijlage II), rules allowing zonnevelden; the zone is quoted verbatim in NC-Z-02. The three proviso's (recognisable structures/landscape integration, soil-water-quality-fitting arrangement, removal duty) are qualitative duties carried as procedural context tags, never guessed as geometry. | zones: gebied_zonneveld | GIO: /jo…

rows.norm: toelichting op art. 5.5 — Omgevingsverordening provincie Utrecht (CVDR704250, geldend 13-10-2025) - toelichting [interpretive]
rows.note: The toelichting to art. 5.5 restricts the article to the landelijk gebied 'met uitzondering van de natura 2000-gebieden en de ganzenrustgebieden' — the same geographic reading as wind FR-W-08. Geometry must come from national sources because no provincial GIO covers these areas. The stedelijk gebied needs no separate exclusion: the Gebied zonneveld designation itself does not extend there. | zone…

rows.criterion: Art. 6.5a third paragraph deviates from its second paragraph for the realisation of new nature as compensation for the placement of a zonneveld: the management measures…
rows.norm: art. 6.5a, derde lid — Omgevingsverordening provincie Utrecht (CVDR704250, geldend 13-10-2025) - artikeltekst [binding]
rows.note: Art. 6.5a lid 3 sets a fully deterministic compensation regime for zonnevelden inside the Groene contour: the compensation new nature (with its management measures) must be realised at the latest 25 years after placement of the panels. Not an elimination: a temporally bounded obligation attached to affected parcels. | zones: groene_contour | GIO: /join/id/regdata/pv26/2025/gioee37db62-22b1-4334-b…

rows.criterion: The (non-binding) Omgevingsvisie 2021 finds wind turbines and zonnevelden in the stedelijk gebied admissible and formulates no further rules for them, with a preference…
rows.norm: par. Duurzame energie (Zonnevelden / Windturbines en zonnevelden in het stedelijk gebied) — Omgevingsvisie provincie Utrecht (PS 10-03-2021, in werking 01-04-2021) - NIET-BINDENDE ambitie [non_binding]
rows.note: Non-binding visie statement of admissibility and preference (roofs/facades/infrastructure first, then industrial estates); the visie formulates no further rules, and the toelichting to art. 5.5 (NC-Z-03) confirms the verordening contains no provisions for solar energy in the stedelijk gebied.
